component.name: SG Mail
component.summary: Mail and calendar in a familiar window

description.p: SG Mail is Stained Glass OS's mail and calendar program. Its window is arranged the way many office workers know: a ribbon, the folder pane, the message list grouped by date with a Focused Inbox, the reading pane, a calendar with Day, Work Week, Week and Month views where appointments are dragged and resized with the mouse, and People for contacts and contact groups.

It is built on Mozilla Thunderbird, which does the work underneath: IMAP, POP and SMTP accounts (with the provider's own sign-in page for Microsoft and Google accounts), the calendar (local, CalDAV and Internet calendars, meeting invitations), the address book and offline storage.
